principles: Published manufacturer odds are the primary probability source.
Checklist-derived allocation is explicit and reproducible.
Team EV remains partial until every included value-bearing card class is covered.
Secondary-source market evidence is provisional and cannot unlock ROI by itself.
Multi-team cards are excluded from team EV until an explicit break-allocation rule is defined.
Probability coverage and market-value coverage are tracked separately.

confidence_levels.provisional: Audited evidence exists but relies on secondary sources.
confidence_levels.medium: Several original-marketplace sales support the modeled values.
confidence_levels.high: Broad original-marketplace verification supports most audited contributions.

roi_gate: The selected team's market-evidence registry must explicitly mark ROI as eligible.
A positive spot price must be entered.
